text.tspan: Covers US 2.0.2. The Add Site flow exists (
[A Site with the same name exists (AT2)]
[Caller is not an Admin, for example a Steward
A new Site is active by default (US 2.0.3 AT5). getSitesOnline reads active Sites, so the new Site
shows in Site search (AT5). The Admin can save after the duplicate warning. The database then refuses an exact duplicate,
because namesite is UNIQUE. The ilike check ignores case, but the UNIQUE constraint does not.
Open question: how a Site links to a boundary in protected_areas. protected_areas.site_id was dropped (20261006010000).
